card.name: Digits inside decimal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token in the middle or end of a multi-digit number, usually after a decimal point, in tables, percentages, confidence intervals and dose values.

modes.label: Decimal digit
modes.description: Digit right after a decimal point in a percentage or ratio.

modes.description: Digit inside a larger whole number or table value.
